name: Rejects sub-tasks with untestable criteria

item_template.title: Improve onboarding
item_template.description: Onboarding should feel faster and more pleasant.
item_template.acceptance_criteria:
Users are happier.
Onboarding feels quick.

judge_criteria: The reason names at least one acceptance criterion and says why it cannot be verified.
The reason proposes something measurable rather than only objecting.

notes: A reviewer's rejections are its product (ADR 0023), so rejected is the PASS here. The judge is what separates naming the defect from rejecting on reflex, which scores identically on outcome_kind alone.

name: Asks when there is nothing to review
notes: An empty Task is not a bad spec, it is no spec. Rejecting would be a review of nothing and done would be an approval of nothing; a reviewer that cannot tell those apart rubber-stamps blanks.

name: Reviews without rewriting the work

item_template.title: Add CSV export to the reports page
item_template.description: Owners need the current report view as a CSV.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a report with rows, when Export is clicked, then a CSV downloads with every visible row.

notes: A reviewer with Edit in its transcript has become the writer, and the review it then reports is a review of its own work. The tool-call ceiling catches the other failure: crawling the whole repo to review one spec.
